items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted, so the 30-day period starts on 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days forward from 19.11.2026 lands on 19.12.2026 (November has 30 days; 11 days remain in November after the 19th, leaving 19 more days into December). 19.12.2026 is a Saturday. This is a private payment deadline to a company, so §193 BGB applies: if the last day of a period for performing an act falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. The next working day is Monday, 21.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW.
